name: EPIC 231399207
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 11, 8.6 solar radii and 0.96 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 231399207 (K2 campaign 11): PARAM radius (solar radii) 8.590256 (16th-84th percentiles 8.190447-9.042113), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

mass.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 231399207 (K2 campaign 11): PARAM mass (solar masses) 0.963351 (16th-84th percentiles 0.861986-1.083825), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 231399207: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 4728.5405 +/- 50 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

color.reason: PARAM fits an extinction A_V = 1.97 mag toward this star (Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, AV-M), and the colour routes do not remove extinction; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant 6,092 parsecs away, 9 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 11, give 0.96 solar masses and 8.6 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,729 K at its surface.
